info.name: Cocos Challenge API
info.description:
Example calls for every endpoint, with a saved example per case: success, REJECTED (201), 400, 404 and 422.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if the API does not run on http://localhost:8080.

Order examples change state (a user's cash and positions). To restore the seed data run `npm run db:reset`. Error codes and status semantics: docs/decisions.md (ADR-03, ADR-23).

response.name: Id is not a number → 400
Id is zero → 400
No params (first page) → 200
